Narrative NV-024
An employee staged a workplace injury to secure unjust compensation. On the incident report, the "witness signature" line remained blank. She later coached a coworker and her physician to align their fabricated stories. The coworker's sworn statement had an empty "corroboration date" field. During the fabricated examination, the doctor's clinical note lacked any entry in the "injury mechanism" column. To ensure the claim survived insurer scrutiny, the employee altered the medical records. Consequently, the amended chart's "revision history" section stayed blank, hiding the tampering. She submitted the fraudulent claim package. The insurer's investigation report eventually closed the file with a definitive "fraud determination" line left permanently empty, though the file itself remained permanently closed.
